Thanks for the quick intake last week. Evergreen's legal and procurement teams asked for a kickoff + redline review; we want to be respectful of everyone's calendars, so wondering if we can compress what is often a multi-session onboarding into one contiguous block with a short follow-up.

- Option A: 75-minute MSA redline walkthrough + 30-minute procurement checklist follow-up (total 105 mins)
- Option B: 60-minute redline + 45-minute procurement deep-dive (total 105 mins)

Two windows we can offer next week (we can also expand to additional days):
- Tues 24 Aug, 15:00–16:45 ET / 19:00–20:45 UTC
- Wed 25 Aug, 11:00–12:45 ET / 15:00–16:45 UTC

Attachments: procurement_preflight_form.xlsx (preflight questions for procurement)

If legal prefers true separation we can split — just trying to limit calendar churn where possible. If either option works, let us know which you prefer and who from legal/procurement will attend (names/emails) so we can build the agenda.

Agenda we imagine:
1) 1–2 minute intros / roles
2) Redline review (clauses & fallbacks)
3) Procurement checklist (SLA, billing, evidence items)
4) Next steps & DocuSign timeline

Thanks,
Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: procurement_preflight_form.xlsx)
